name: Micha
overview: The biblical figure Micha is identified as a Levite connected to the worship and service of God in Jerusalem. The verses in Nehemiah highlight Micha's lineage, showing his descendants involved in leading thanksgiving and overseeing the ministry of music and worship in the temple. This underscores the important role of Micha's family within the Levitical order dedicated to the house of God, emphasizing faithful service and leadership in spiritual duties.
